subject: Remediation progress: auth token rotation, audit logs, network hardening (NovaBank)
messages:
From: PenTests Glyph <pentests@glyphsec.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, security@novabank.com
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Glyph Security: clarification & evidence request for NovaBank pen test report

Hi Ava / NovaBank security team,

Thanks for the chance to work on the engagement. We sent over the consolidated pen test PDF (attached) but a few findings need clarification to complete our SIG/SOC2 evidence pack:

1) FINDING 4.1 — persistent auth token reuse observed during session replay on /api/v1/generate: can you confirm whether tokens are rotated server-side and provide the token policy/config?

2) FINDING 6.2 — missing application-level audit logs for service "kv-cache" between 2026-04-16 and 2026-04-20 (we saw no structured audit events). We need example logs or a confirmation that audited logging has been enabled and retained.

3) FINDING 9.3 — overly permissive egress from the analytics subnet (10.142.0.0/20) to external endpoints on non-standard ports. Please provide the network rule changes or compensating controls planned.

Can you provide an ETA for remediation and a list of artifacts we can include in the evidence bundle (config snippets, log exports, JIRA tickets, screenshots, signed attestations)? If you expect any findings to remain open at time of SOC 2 readiness, note that explicitly.

Attachment: glyph-pt-report-v2.pdf (PDF, 3.2MB)

Thanks,
Ben Alvarez
Senior Consultant, Glyph Security
pentests@glyphsec.com

On behalf of NovaBank security: please include any SOC 2 relevant artifacts we can attach to the security assessment.

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: PenTests Glyph <pentests@glyphsec.com>, security@novabank.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Glyph Security: clarification & evidence request for NovaBank pen test report

Hi Ben / NovaBank team — thanks for the report and clear ask. We’ve triaged the three findings you called out and put together a remediation roadmap + ETA for evidence handoff below. I’ve also attached a summarized remediation plan.

Summary (high-level):
- FINDING 4.1 (auth token rotation): Owner Rishi Malhotra. Action: enforce short-lived access tokens (15m), implement immediate server-side rotation on refresh, and add token invalidation on logout. JIRA: INF-4122. Target complete: 2026-05-25. Evidence: config diff (auth-service config), token policy snippet, sample rotated token trace (redacted).

- FINDING 6.2 (kv-cache audit logs): Owner Marissa Cole. Action: enable structured audit events in kv-cache (JSON schema) and ship logs to long-term store (log-archive-prod). JIRA: INF-4130. Target complete: 2026-05-24. Evidence: exported log sample (2026-05-24 03:00–04:00 UTC), logging config, retention policy doc.

- FINDING 9.3 (analytics subnet egress): Owner Vivek Kulkarni. Action: tighten egress rules to allow only whitelisted destinations and force proxy for non-whitelisted flows; add network egress monitoring. JIRA: INF-4151. Target complete (phase 1): 2026-06-03. Evidence: security group diff, iptables snapshot, network flow logs showing blocked flows.

Planned handoff cadence: we will deliver the first bundle (auth + logging artifacts) by 2026-05-27 and the final egress hardening evidence by 2026-06-03. If anything slips we will flag it immediately.

Attachments: redwood-remediation-plan-v1.docx

Short asks for Glyph: please confirm what format you prefer for log samples (raw gz vs JSON lines) and whether a redacted sample is acceptable for the SOC 2 folder. Also confirm whether the JIRA IDs above are sufficient cross-references in your evidence report.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com
(415) 555-0132

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: NovaBank pen test — task assignments and acceptance criteria

Rishi / Marissa — assigning the items below. Keep everything scoped to production only (do not run data exports from customer PII zones). Follow these acceptance criteria exactly so we can hand over evidence:

Rishi (INF-4122)
- Implement token rotation and add server-side invalidation endpoint.
- Provide: (a) one-line config diff, (b) sample request/response showing rotated token (redacted), (c) unit test snapshot proving token invalidation.
- ETA: 2026-05-25 COB.

Marissa (INF-4130)
- Enable JSON audit events for kv-cache; ensure events include user_id, request_id, action, timestamp.
- Ship a 24h sample to log-archive-prod; provide retention policy and console screenshot showing events.
- ETA: 2026-05-24 EOD.

Vivek (INF-4151)
- I’ll drive the egress ACL changes and the proxy enforcement for analytics stack. Plan a phased rollout: canary on 5 hosts -> full rollout. Provide network flow logs and security group diffs.

If you hit any blockers (especially around backwards compatibility for tokens or log ingestion throughput), flag now and we’ll open a remediation sprint.

—Vivek

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: PenTests Glyph <pentests@glyphsec.com>, security@novabank.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2026 09:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Glyph Security: clarification & evidence request for NovaBank pen test report — partial evidence delivery (auth + logs)

Hi Ben / NovaBank team — delivering the first evidence bundle for the three items you flagged. Summary below and attached artifacts.

Completed items (delivered 2026-05-27):
1) FINDING 4.1 (auth token rotation) — Completed 2026-05-25
- Artifacts: auth-config-diff.patch, token-policy.md, rotated-token-trace.json.gz (redacted).
- JIRA: INF-4122 (links included in drive folder).

2) FINDING 6.2 (kv-cache audit logs) — Completed 2026-05-24
- Artifacts: kv-audit-sample-20260524.jsonl.gz, logging-config-v2.yaml, retention_policy.pdf.
- Note: sample covers 2026-05-24 00:00–23:59 UTC and has been redacted to remove PII.

Open item (in progress):
3) FINDING 9.3 (analytics subnet egress hardening) — Phase 1 complete on canary hosts; full rollout in progress.
- Current status: ACLs applied to canary hosts, proxy enforcement enabled for 6/8 analytics nodes, monitoring in place.
- ETA for full evidence handoff: 2026-06-03 (we expect to include security group diffs and blocked-flow logs).

Attachments (in evidence bundle): evidence-bundle-novabank-0527.zip (contains the artifacts listed above), plus a CSV manifest.

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-remediation-novabank (access: NovaBank security + Glyph Security)

Ben — please confirm receipt and whether the redacted log sample format (JSON lines gz) is acceptable for your SOC 2 pack. If you need the raw syslog outputs we can coordinate a supervised transfer.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com

From: Ben Alvarez <pentests@glyphsec.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, security@novabank.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Glyph Security: clarification & evidence request for NovaBank pen test report — partial evidence delivery (auth + logs)

Ava / Vivek / NovaBank team — thanks for the quick turnaround and for the evidence bundle. We pulled the JSON-lines sample and the config diffs and those are acceptable for the SOC 2 artifacts.

One outstanding ask: once you have the full egress hardening evidence (security group diffs and blocked-flow logs), please upload to the shared drive and notify us. Also, can we schedule a 30-minute handshake call next week to review the final artifacts and sign the closure memo?

Proposed times: Tue 2026-06-08 09:00–09:30 PT or Wed 2026-06-09 13:00–13:30 PT. Let me know which works.

Regards,
Ben
